title: Brand discovery & stakeholder workshops
description: Kickoff workshop, stakeholder interviews, competitive audit, and alignment on brand direction. Includes up to 3 stakeholder review loops (e.g. Johan-type reviewer). Output: discovery summary document. Scope: ~30h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Brand concept & direction
description: Visual concept development — logo usage system, color palette, typography pairing, graphic language, tone of visual. Presented as 1-2 distinct directions for client to choose from. Scope: ~50h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Brand guidelines document
description: PDF brand book (10-20 pages) documenting logo usage, colors (with hex/RGB/CMYK/Pantone), typography, graphic elements, do's and don'ts, and application examples. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Brand asset kit delivery
description: Final digital asset kit: logos in SVG/PNG/PDF (light/dark variants), favicon set, color tokens (CSS/JSON), font files with license info, templated cover images. Zipped and delivered to client Dropbox. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Brand identity — full package
description: Bundle of BRD-001 through BRD-004 at a packaged rate. Complete brand identity system from discovery to delivered asset kit. Sriracha leads; client reviews at 3 milestones.

title: Value-words discovery session (compact)
description: Single 60-min working session to land brand value words and adjacency references. Output: brand attitude summary. Scope: ~10h including prep and write-up.

title: Logo refinement from existing direction
description: Iteration on an existing logo/wordmark (not ground-up design). Includes symbol refinement, wordmark lockup, alternate lockups, and monochrome variants. Scope: ~28h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Color + typography system
description: Color palette (primary + secondary + functional) and typography system (display, body, functional). Delivered as tokens and visual reference. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Graphic language rules
description: Rules for recurring graphic elements (e.g. swoosh treatments, imagery motifs). Defines when to use each element and what combinations are off-limits. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Brand guidelines document (compact)
description: Shorter brand lathund (~10 pages) when the system is less complex than a full brand book. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Brand asset kit (compact)
description: Digital asset kit for a focused brand system. Scope: ~10h.

title: Brand identity — compact package
description: Bundle of BRD-101 through BRD-106. Suited for internal brands or sub-brands where the parent visual direction already exists. Sriracha leads.

title: Explainer video — script & concept
description: Script development with 2 drafts and a locked version. Concept document describing visual metaphor and pacing. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Explainer video — storyboard
description: Frame-by-frame storyboard aligned to script, delivered as annotated PDF. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Explainer video — design frames
description: Key design frames establishing visual style, color, typography in motion. ~8-12 hero frames produced at final quality. Scope: ~38h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Explainer video — motion graphics animation
description: Full motion graphics animation for a 60-90s explainer in After Effects. Includes scene transitions, data visualization, and character/object motion. Scope: ~90h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Explainer video — voiceover direction
description: Casting brief, session direction with external VO talent, and VO editing into final track. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h. External VO talent cost billed separately.

title: Explainer video — sound design & music supervision
description: Sound design pass, music track selection/direction, mix to broadcast-ready loudness. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h. External music license billed separately.

title: Explainer video — revisions (2 rounds)
description: Two full rounds of client revisions on motion, timing, copy, or VO. Third+ round billed hourly. Scope: ~28h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Explainer video (60-90s) — full package
description: Bundle of VID-001 through VID-007. One motion graphics explainer video at 60-90 seconds, Swedish VO, web-ready MP4 + subtitle SRT. External costs (VO talent, music) billed separately.

title: Explainer video — English VO version
description: Add-on: English-language voiceover and subtitle variant of an existing explainer. Includes translation review, VO session, re-edit. Scope: ~18h at 1000 SEK/h. External English VO talent billed separately.

title: Website strategy & sitemap
description: Discovery, competitor review, sitemap definition, content outline. Output: strategy document with approved sitemap. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Website interaction & visual design
description: Full visual design in Figma for desktop + mobile, including interaction patterns for any custom walkthroughs or animations. ~8-12 unique layouts. Scope: ~65h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Website copywriting (first draft)
description: Copy for all site sections, SEO-aware, in Swedish. Client reviews and edits. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Website development — Next.js
description: Implementation of designs in Next.js (App Router), responsive across mobile/tablet/desktop, optimized for Core Web Vitals. Includes form handling, basic animation, and sitemap/robots setup. Scope: ~105h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Website launch & QA
description: Cross-browser QA, Lighthouse optimization pass, content loading, DNS cutover, SSL verification, 30-day post-launch bugfix window. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Website revisions (2 rounds)
description: Two full rounds of design/dev revisions after first handover. Third+ round billed hourly. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Website — design & build full package
description: Bundle of WEB-001 through WEB-006. Complete Next.js site delivered live on client's Vercel account. Replaces existing Framer/static site.

title: Vercel Pro setup
description: Set up Vercel Pro project under client account, connect GitHub, configure custom domain, DNS, SSL, environment variables, preview deployments. Recurring ~220 SEK/mo paid by client directly. Scope: ~3h.

title: Vercel Hobby setup (free tier)
description: Set up Vercel Hobby project (free) for MVP/early-stage projects. Includes domain, DNS, SSL. No cost to client for hosting. Scope: ~2h.

title: Sanity CMS integration (free tier)
description: Integrate Sanity.io CMS with the Next.js site. Define schemas for pages, sections, and reusable blocks. Non-technical staff can edit copy/images/sections via web UI. Free tier covers 3 users / 2 datasets. Scope: ~28h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Sanity CMS Growth plan config
description: Upgrade configuration for Sanity Growth plan — roles, approval workflows, expanded datasets. Client pays ~1100 SEK/mo directly. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Payload CMS self-hosted integration
description: Alternative to Sanity — Payload CMS self-hosted in same Vercel deployment. Fully open source, no per-seat costs. Scope: ~40h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Plausible analytics setup
description: Install Plausible (cookieless, no consent banner needed in Sweden). Configure goal tracking for key CTAs. Recurring ~105 SEK/mo paid by client. Scope: ~4h.

title: PostHog free tier integration
description: Install PostHog for funnels, session replay, feature flags, A/B test infrastructure. Free up to 1M events/mo. Scope: ~8h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Analytics growth pack (Plausible + PostHog)
description: Bundled ANL-001 + ANL-002 with cross-tool event mapping and a starter dashboard. Recommended default.

title: GA4 setup with consent banner
description: Install GA4 with Google Tag Manager and a GDPR-compliant consent management platform. Includes cookie banner UI. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Lead capture form (basic)
description: On-page form (name, email, postnummer, elförbrukning etc.) that sends submissions to a client email via Resend (3k emails/mo free). Includes server-side validation and spam protection. Scope: ~8h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: HubSpot Free CRM integration
description: Wire the on-page form to HubSpot Free CRM. Leads land in a proper pipeline with ownership, status, deal stages. Includes property mapping, duplicate handling, and welcome email templates. HubSpot Free tier 0 SEK/mo. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: HubSpot Marketing Starter full setup
description: HubSpot Marketing Starter with workflows, lead scoring, Calendly round-robin assignment, SMS triggers, and behavior-based segments. Recurring ~220+ SEK/mo paid by client. Scope: ~40h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Custom CRM integration (Pipedrive/Upsales/Lime)
description: Alternative to HubSpot — integrate on-page form and lead flow into an existing CRM of client's choice. Scope varies with CRM API maturity; starting estimate ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Calendly basic embed
description: Embed existing Calendly link as CTA on new site. Configure event types and confirmation emails. Scope: ~2h.

title: Calendly team + HubSpot integration
description: Calendly Standard with multi-user round-robin, integrated with HubSpot for lead attribution. Recurring ~110 SEK/seat/mo paid by client. Scope: ~6h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Cal.com self-hosted white-labeled
description: Self-host Cal.com under client domain (e.g. lystr.se/boka). Full white-label, no Calendly branding. Client pays ~55 SEK/seat/mo. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Email starter — Mailchimp free
description: Mailchimp Free setup (500 contacts) with one welcome email on lead form signup and one monthly newsletter template. Scope: ~15h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Email automation — advanced flows
description: Klaviyo / HubSpot Marketing Pro / ActiveCampaign setup with segmented nurture flows, behavior-triggered emails, lead scoring. Recurring ~500+ SEK/mo paid by client. Scope: ~45h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: SEO technical foundation
description: Clean semantic HTML, meta tags, sitemap, OG/Twitter cards, Core Web Vitals green, Google Search Console + Bing verification. Typically bundled with web build — offered standalone for existing sites. Scope: ~10h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: SEO content & schema pack
description: Schema.org markup (LocalBusiness, Product, FAQ, BreadcrumbList), keyword research, 5-8 SEO-targeted content pages with copy. Scope: ~33h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: SEO monthly retainer
description: Ongoing SEO: new content (2 pieces/mo), link building, competitive monitoring, quarterly technical audit. Minimum 3-month commitment. ~25h/month at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint master template — light only
description: Reusable .pptx master template with 12-15 slide layouts, based on approved brand system. Fully editable in PowerPoint. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint populated deck (~20 slides)
description: Content-populated deck (~15-25 slides) using the master template. First draft in PowerPoint, client fills in final specifics. Scope: ~33h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint deck revisions
description: Two full rounds of slide revisions. Third+ round billed hourly. Scope: ~10h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint sales deck — full package
description: Bundle of PPT-001 + PPT-002 + PPT-003. Ready-to-use sales/partner deck derived from brand system.

title: PowerPoint template architecture & grid
description: Template foundation: master slides, grid system, color/font tokens, placeholder logic so native PowerPoint editing works without breaking layout. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint slide layouts — light variant
description: ~18 master slide layouts for the light-mode variant: cover, section divider, title+body, two-column, large image, image grid, quote, data, comparison, talent intro, format breakdown, sponsor integration, timeline, contact. Scope: ~45h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint slide layouts — dark variant
description: ~18 master slide layouts mirrored from light to dark. Reuses light layout architecture; adapts color and contrast. Scope: ~32h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint element library
description: Reusable icon set, chart styles, callout blocks, dividers, and component snippets embedded in the template. Scope: ~25h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint QA — native edit testing
description: Verify all layouts edit natively in PowerPoint without layout breakage, font substitution, or image fidelity loss. Test across macOS and Windows PowerPoint. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint template revisions
description: Two rounds of revisions on the master template. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: PowerPoint master template — light + dark full package
description: Bundle of PPT-101 through PPT-106. Complete dual-mode PowerPoint template system.

title: Mockup pitch deck — content adaptation
description: Adapt existing raw pitch content into the approved template. Includes content editing and structural improvements. Scope: ~20h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Mockup pitch deck — custom slide design
description: Design ~20-25 slides using template layouts plus bespoke layouts where needed for a specific pitch (sponsor, investor). Scope: ~32h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Mockup pitch deck — image sourcing
description: Source stock or AI-generated imagery for pitch slides, with client-replaceable placeholders noted. Scope: ~12h at 1000 SEK/h. External stock license billed separately.

title: Mockup pitch deck — revisions
description: Two rounds of revisions. Scope: ~10h at 1000 SEK/h.

title: Mockup pitch deck — full package
description: Bundle of PPT-108 through PPT-111. A single populated pitch deck (~20-25 slides) demonstrating how the template works when filled out.

title: Project management — hourly
description: Weekly check-ins, client coordination, stakeholder alignment (e.g. with a Johan-type reviewer), file handover, invoicing coordination, post-delivery questions within 30 days. Typically sized at 10-15% of total project hours.

title: Ad-hoc development / design
description: Overflow hours for work outside agreed scope — bug fixes, small tweaks, urgent changes. Billed hourly against an agreed cap.

title: Managed service — Maintenance
description: 4h/month. Includes bug fixes, minor copy edits, monthly analytics snapshot, uptime monitoring. Month-to-month; 30-day cancellation notice.

title: Managed service — Growth
description: 12h/month. Includes all Maintenance tasks plus monthly landing-page A/B test, quarterly content update, conversion review. Most common tier. Month-to-month; 30-day cancellation notice.

title: Managed service — Full-service
description: 30h/month. Includes all Growth tasks plus monthly creative iteration, email campaign design, SEO content, paid-media creative support. Effectively an outsourced digital team. Month-to-month; 30-day cancellation notice.

title: Voice-over talent — Swedish
description: Professional Swedish voice-over talent for an explainer/commercial video. One session + delivery. Passthrough cost; billed at actual.

title: Voice-over talent — English
description: Professional English voice-over talent for an international version of a video asset. One session + delivery. Passthrough cost; billed at actual.

title: Music license — library track
description: License fee for a library music track (Artlist, Epidemic Sound tier). Passthrough cost.

title: Music — custom composition
description: Bespoke music composition for a video asset. Passthrough cost through a composer partner.

title: Stock imagery — single image
description: Single premium stock image (Getty/Adobe Stock standard license). Passthrough cost.

title: Stock imagery — pack
description: 10-image bundle from a major stock provider.

title: Font license — display/brand font
description: Desktop and web licensing for a premium display or brand font. Held in client's name.
